title: A Wild Cat That Dives Underwater and Ambushes Ducks From Below
subject: fishing cat

scenes.text: Cats hate water. This one dives in and hunts underwater.
It's the fishing cat of South Asia. Its paws are partly webbed.
It crouches at the edge, then plunges in after fish farther from the bank.
It can even swim under a duck and attack it from below as it surfaces.
Scientists think it taps the surface to look like an insect and lure fish in. Fish are about three quarters of its diet in one park.
A house cat's nightmare. A cat that fishes with bait.

description:
Cats hate water. The fishing cat dives in after its food.
It even attacks ducks from below and may tap the water like an insect to lure fish.
Would your cat ever do this? Comment below.
